cases.name: Kimberly "Kim" Kay Halstead
cases.about:
Her obituary said. "he was a 1990 graduate of Muncie South High School where she was a cheerleader mascot.  Kim worked at Lowe’s in Muncie before moving to Michigan less than two years ago.  In Michigan she had worked at Dollar General and was currently employed with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.  She loved animals, especially dolphins, and enjoyed listening to New Kids On The Block."
